comment: explode.c explode() 684-685, pay_for_damage() after an explosion damages a shop door: in Kopasker's general store on Dlvl 3 (seed from a bounded 7302101-7302400 scan for a ^V arrival in a shop), a debug Samurai steps diagonally beside the open west door, closes it (the first try resists) and breaks a wished wand of lightning. The ball of lightning splinters the door (zap_over_floor() sets shopdamage), so explode() calls pay_for_damage('destroy'), and the keeper asks 'How dare you destroy my door?'. The blast is fatal; the debug-mode 'Die?' prompt is answered n. 684 is the AD_DISN choice and runs because the conditional expression's lines are evaluated in turn.
